All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.

translations.web: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.
translations.bsb: Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.
translations.kjv: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
